conventions.transform: column vectors R @ source_point + (0,0,-minimum_rotated_z); proper signed permutation only; XY unchanged after rotation
conventions.bed_area: sum full triangles with all grounded vertices z<=numerical tolerance; no partial triangle clipping; not physical adhesion/contact tolerance
conventions.near_bed_hull: convex hull of vertices z<=numerical tolerance; includes gaps; geometric containment is not stability or adhesion assessment
conventions.com: native raw BRep geometric volume centroid transformed as a provisional uniform-volume COM; printed density, infill, material and installed frame unknown
conventions.overhang_angle: outward winding-normal n, downward if n_z < -1e-12; angle=atan2(-n_z,hypot(n_x,n_y)), equivalent to asin(-n_z); from vertical wall0deg to downward horizontal90deg; full near-bed triangles excluded from above-bed bins
conventions.numerical_invariants: signed winding volume and triangle area preserved within relative1e-12/absolute1e-9; no float32 rewrite
